c74object.name: evi.butterworthlp6~
c74object.digest: Unique 6th order Butterworth Lowpass filter created from evi.bp~ sections after Miller Puckette
c74object.description:
evi.butterworthlp6~ is a 'max define' for the evi_butterworthlp6.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.butterworthlp6~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
A smooth 6th order butterworth lowpass with very interesting properties being made up of three resonant filter sections.

inlet.digest: Inlet #2: Cutoff in Hz @min samplerate*0.000041 @max samplerate*0.470588

c74object.discussion: Miller Puckette devised this for his 'SMECK' project. For more information about other reimplementations of Pd filters in evieve, see the 'evieve pd' tab of the helpfile.
